text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r d-e-f-i-n-e-d t-h-e c-l-o-s-e d e x-e-r-c-i-s-e a-s a c-o-n-t-a-i-n-e-d r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e and r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d t-h-e i-n-i-t-i-a-l i-n-t-e-n-t as a f-o-u-n-d a-t-i-o-n while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-s-c-o-p-i-n-g v-a-l-i-d-a-t-i-o-n.
2) they r-e-t-a-i-n-e-d t-h-e r-a-w t-r-a-n-s-c-r-i-p-tion as a f-i-l-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t for i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e and l-a-b-e-l-e-d it as s-e-a-l-e-d and a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-t-e-x-t u-p-d-a-t-e.
3) the p-e-r-s-o-n n-o-t-e-d t-h-e c-a-s-e n-u-m-b-e-r in t-h-e s-t-a-t-u-s log to m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n a c-l-e-a-r a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l and d-i-d n-o-t d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e any m-e-t-h-o-d-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-b-r-i-e-f c-h-e-c-k-l-i-s-t.
4) they r-e-c-o-g-n-i-z-e-d t-h-e a-s-s-i-s-t-a-n-t must d-e-c-l-i-n-e d-e-t-a-i-l e-d guidance on f-o-r-g-e r-y and r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d t-h-e d-e-c-l-i-n-a-t-i-o-n in the n-o-t-e-s and l-e-f-t the r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e as a r-e-f-u-s-a-l while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-g s-t-e-p.
5) the t-e-a-m c-l-o-s-e-d the m-a-t-t-e-r as d-o-n-e and m-a-r-k-e-d the e-x-h-i-b-i-t as n-o-t-e-d only for i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e and f-i-l-e-d the f-i-n-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-e-c-o-n-d r-e-v-i-e-w.
